title: Impulse Space media slot
description: A media slot that a real image or video fills like object-fit: cover. Empty, it is a flat muted surface with a faint glow rising from its foot (or, as a 'render', a faint flat rounded square for a product cut-out), so it reads plainly as a placeholder.
notes: size and round it from outside (aspect-*, h-full, rounded-lg); it fills its box
name: impulsespace-placeholder

props.name: media
props.description: a real image or video; it is stretched to cover the slot. Empty: a plain token surface

props.name: label
props.description: what the slot will show, for screen readers (only used while it is empty)

props.name: kind
props.description: scene: a photo / video frame (muted, faint glow at the foot) · render: a product cut-out (a faint flat square, no frame)
